hbe_mill_magistrate: Magistrate Orrin Pell. I sit outside the gate of Tarren Mill because everything east of the mill is my problem: gnolls in the hollow, Syndicate in the keep, ogres in the stead, and a wall in the south-east that nobody could open until lately.
hbe_mill_apothecary: Wren, field apothecary. I work the ground outside Tarren Mill's gate. I sample the ditches so the ones inside the town do not have to. It is a career. The water coming down from Alterac has something new in it.
hbe_mill_deathguard: Deathguard Kolt. The gate of Tarren Mill is behind me and the road is in front of you. West goes back to the Foothills, south-east to Durnholde. Mind which way you are facing when you draw.
hbe_naze_infiltrator: Vess. Infiltrator. That camp east of us is Gavin's Naze - a fence's camp with delusions. Everything stolen in this valley passes through it, and lately some things that were not stolen from anywhere I can name.
hbe_mill_caravan_master: Ovid Thane, caravan master. My wagons load outside the Tarren Mill gate. Flour out, reagents in, twice a month, down the west road and up through Silverpine. The Syndicate has started taking an interest in my wheels.
hbe_mill_hunter: Dell Varrow. I was gamekeeper to the people who owned these fields. Now I hunt for the people who hold them. Worgs in the hedgerows round the mill, gnolls in Mudsnout Hollow to the west. I am a different sort of keeper now.
hbe_hollow_trapper: Gus Mirren, trapper. Mudsnout Hollow is the dip just west of here, and it is full of gnolls. They took my whole line of snares and left me the stakes. Insulting, that. I want the line back.
hbe_west_outrider: Outrider Jace. I ride the west road, from the Western Hillsbrad border to the mill and back, all day and most of the night. It has never once been quiet. Tarren Mill is north-east of here if you keep to it.
hbe_durnholde_watcher: Watcher Odrin Falk. That ring of walls east of me is Durnholde Keep. It has been held by the Syndicate longer than it was ever held by Lordaeron. Think on that. I watch the archway and I write down who goes in.
hbe_durnholde_scholar: Emeline Vask, scholar. I study Durnholde from outside it - the archway is just north-east of us. Thrall was kept in that keep as a boy. Half the Horde's history started behind those walls, and the Horde has never once asked to see them.
hbe_west_gate_scout: Scout Pria Halm. This is the west edge of Eastern Hillsbrad. The road behind me goes back to the Foothills and Southpoint. The road ahead goes east to Tarren Mill and then to everything that wants you dead. Choose carefully.
hbe_stead_outrider: Brann Odgar, outrider. Nethander Stead be right dere, east of me, in de east of de valley. De ogres took da stead. Dey took da barn too, and dey are living in it. I want da barn back at least.
hbe_garok_sapper: Niall Crag, sapper. Dun Garok is the fort in the ridge just south-east of this spot. Dwarves cut it square into the rock. I have been told to find a way in that is not the door, and I have been here long enough to respect the door.
hbe_strand_tidewatcher: Tidewatcher Ferris. This is the Eastern Strand, the south coast below Tarren Mill. Daggerspine murlocs on this strand too. They are spreading along the whole shore, and nobody will say from where.
hbe_wall_sentry: Sentry Ada Rook. Thoradin's Wall is the line of stone south-east of me, at the very corner of the valley. Built by an empire that is dust, and it still closes the road - or it did. There is a gap in it now, and Arathi on the far side.
